# Settings a save does not have yet (added by a later version) get their default;
# set_variable keeps a variable at 0, only clear_variable removes one.
atm_fill_missing = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = atm_on } } set_variable = { atm_on = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = atm_dry } } set_variable = { atm_dry = 0 } }

# Version 1 -> 2: every priority is a rank 1..9 now (stored as points = 10 - rank, 0 unset, -99 banned).
# Old values: resource priority 0/1/2 -> rank 8/5/2; category and continent weights -2..2 -> points 0/0/0/3/6;
# country and faction assignment +10 / -10 -> 1st rank (9 points) / unset.
atm_migrate_v2 = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_prio_oil = 0 } } set_variable = { atm_prio_oil = 8 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_prio_oil = 1 } } set_variable = { atm_prio_oil = 5 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_prio_oil = 2 } } set_variable = { atm_prio_oil = 2 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_prio_aluminium = 0 } } set_variable = { atm_prio_aluminium = 8 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_prio_aluminium = 1 } } set_variable = { atm_prio_aluminium = 5 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_prio_aluminium = 2 } } set_variable = { atm_prio_aluminium = 2 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_prio_rubber = 0 } } set_variable = { atm_prio_rubber = 8 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_prio_rubber = 1 } } set_variable = { atm_prio_rubber = 5 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_prio_rubber = 2 } } set_variable = { atm_prio_rubber = 2 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_prio_tungsten = 0 } } set_variable = { atm_prio_tungsten = 8 } }

# Version 2 -> 3: a country's score is the sum of (points - 5) now (5th rank = unset = neutral), so the
# land trade default moves from the 9th rank (1 point) to the 4th rank (6 points): still +1 over sea trade.
atm_migrate_v3 = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_w_land = 1 } } set_variable = { atm_w_land = 6 } }
	set_country_flag = atm_dirty   # the stored scores were summed the old way: recompute
}

# Version 3 -> 4: the cut / move interval is 1 day by default now (it was 5, with the DLL enforcing at least 3).
atm_migrate_v4 = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_cooldown = 5 } } set_variable = { atm_cooldown = 1 } }
}

# First use on this country; afterwards only what a newer version added is filled in.
atm_init = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = atm_initialized } }
		atm_set_defaults = yes
		set_variable = { atm_tab = 1 }
		set_variable = { atm_filter = 0 }
		set_variable = { atm_version = 4 }
		set_country_flag = atm_initialized
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { atm_version = 4 } } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_version < 2 } } atm_migrate_v2 = yes }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_version < 3 } } atm_migrate_v3 = yes }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_version < 4 } } atm_migrate_v4 = yes }
		atm_fill_missing = yes
	}
}

# Partner scores: every other country gets atm_score (sum of the rule weights that match)
# and atm_ban (1 = never trade). atm_pin (set in the country list) overrides: >0 lifts bans.
atm_recompute_scores = {
	every_country = {
		limit = { exists = yes NOT = { tag = ROOT } }
		set_variable = { atm_score = 0 }
		set_variable = { atm_ban = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { is_in_faction_with = ROOT }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.atm_w_faction < -50 } } set_variable = { atm_ban = 1 } }
			else = {
				add_to_variable = { atm_score = ROOT.atm_w_faction }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.atm_w_faction > 0 } } add_to_variable = { atm_score = -5 } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_subject_of = ROOT }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.atm_w_subject < -50 } } set_variable = { atm_ban = 1 } }
			else = {
				add_to_variable = { atm_score = ROOT.atm_w_subject }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.atm_w_subject > 0 } } add_to_variable = { atm_score = -5 } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { ROOT = { is_subject_of = PREV } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.atm_w_overlord < -50 } } set_variable = { atm_ban = 1 } }
			else = {
				add_to_variable = { atm_score = ROOT.atm_w_overlord }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.atm_w_overlord > 0 } } add_to_variable = { atm_score = -5 } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { has_guaranteed = ROOT ROOT = { has_guaranteed = PREV } } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.atm_w_guarantee < -50 } } set_variable = { atm_ban = 1 } }
			else = {
				add_to_variable = { atm_score = ROOT.atm_w_guarantee }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.atm_w_guarantee > 0 } } add_to_variable = { atm_score = -5 } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { atm_same_ideology = yes }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.atm_w_ideology < -50 } } set_variable = { atm_ban = 1 } }
			else = {
				add_to_variable = { atm_score = ROOT.atm_w_ideology }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.atm_w_ideology > 0 } } add_to_variable = { atm_score = -5 } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_neighbor_of = ROOT }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.atm_w_neighbor < -50 } } set_variable = { atm_ban = 1 } }
			else = {
				add_to_variable = { atm_score = ROOT.atm_w_neighbor }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.atm_w_neighbor > 0 } } add_to_variable = { atm_score = -5 } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { atm_same_continent = yes }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.atm_w_samecont < -50 } } set_variable = { atm_ban = 1 } }
			else = {
				add_to_variable = { atm_score = ROOT.atm_w_samecont }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.atm_w_samecont > 0 } } add_to_variable = { atm_score = -5 } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_major = yes }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.atm_w_major < -50 } } set_variable = { atm_ban = 1 } }
			else = {
				add_to_variable = { atm_score = ROOT.atm_w_major }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.atm_w_major > 0 } } add_to_variable = { atm_score = -5 } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_war = yes }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.atm_w_atwar < -50 } } set_variable = { atm_ban = 1 } }
			else = {
				add_to_variable = { atm_score = ROOT.atm_w_atwar }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.atm_w_atwar > 0 } } add_to_variable = { atm_score = -5 } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { atm_allied_with_enemy = yes }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.atm_w_enemyally < -50 } } set_variable = { atm_ban = 1 } }
			else = {
				add_to_variable = { atm_score = ROOT.atm_w_enemyally }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.atm_w_enemyally > 0 } } add_to_variable = { atm_score = -5 } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { capital_scope = { is_on_continent = europe } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.atm_wc_europe < -50 } } set_variable = { atm_ban = 1 } }
			else = {
				add_to_variable = { atm_score = ROOT.atm_wc_europe }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.atm_wc_europe > 0 } } add_to_variable = { atm_score = -5 } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { capital_scope = { is_on_continent = north_america } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.atm_wc_north_america < -50 } } set_variable = { atm_ban = 1 } }
			else = {
				add_to_variable = { atm_score = ROOT.atm_wc_north_america }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.atm_wc_north_america > 0 } } add_to_variable = { atm_score = -5 } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { capital_scope = { is_on_continent = south_america } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.atm_wc_south_america < -50 } } set_variable = { atm_ban = 1 } }
			else = {
				add_to_variable = { atm_score = ROOT.atm_wc_south_america }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.atm_wc_south_america > 0 } } add_to_variable = { atm_score = -5 } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { capital_scope = { is_on_continent = africa } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.atm_wc_africa < -50 } } set_variable = { atm_ban = 1 } }
			else = {
				add_to_variable = { atm_score = ROOT.atm_wc_africa }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.atm_wc_africa > 0 } } add_to_variable = { atm_score = -5 } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { capital_scope = { is_on_continent = asia } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.atm_wc_asia < -50 } } set_variable = { atm_ban = 1 } }
			else = {
				add_to_variable = { atm_score = ROOT.atm_wc_asia }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.atm_wc_asia > 0 } } add_to_variable = { atm_score = -5 } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { capital_scope = { is_on_continent = australia } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.atm_wc_australia < -50 } } set_variable = { atm_ban = 1 } }
			else = {
				add_to_variable = { atm_score = ROOT.atm_wc_australia }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.atm_wc_australia > 0 } } add_to_variable = { atm_score = -5 } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { capital_scope = { is_on_continent = middle_east } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.atm_wc_middle_east < -50 } } set_variable = { atm_ban = 1 } }
			else = {
				add_to_variable = { atm_score = ROOT.atm_wc_middle_east }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.atm_wc_middle_east > 0 } } add_to_variable = { atm_score = -5 } }
			}
		}
	}
	# Faction assignments (atm_fpin on the faction leader). Factions change during a game, so the pin is
	# looked up from the CURRENT leader every time. A pin left on a member that is no longer the leader
	# moves to the new leader (when it has none); on a country outside any faction it is dropped.
	every_country = {
		limit = { exists = yes is_faction_leader = no NOT = { check_variable = { atm_fpin = 0 } } }
		if = {
			limit = { is_in_faction = yes }
			faction_leader = {
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_fpin = 0 } } set_variable = { atm_fpin = PREV.atm_fpin } }
			}
		}
		clear_variable = atm_fpin
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = { exists = yes is_faction_leader = yes NOT = { check_variable = { atm_fpin = 0 } } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { tag = ROOT } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_fpin < -50 } } set_variable = { atm_ban = 1 } }
			else = {
				add_to_variable = { atm_score = atm_fpin }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_fpin > 0 } } add_to_variable = { atm_score = -5 } }
			}
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { exists = yes NOT = { tag = ROOT } NOT = { tag = PREV } is_in_faction_with = PREV }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { PREV.atm_fpin < -50 } } set_variable = { atm_ban = 1 } }
			else = {
				add_to_variable = { atm_score = PREV.atm_fpin }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { PREV.atm_fpin > 0 } } add_to_variable = { atm_score = -5 } }
			}
		}
	}
	# Country assignments override everything above (>0 lifts any ban).
	every_country = {
		limit = { exists = yes NOT = { tag = ROOT } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { atm_pin < -50 } }
			set_variable = { atm_ban = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { atm_pin > 0 } }
			set_variable = { atm_ban = 0 }
			add_to_variable = { atm_score = atm_pin }
			add_to_variable = { atm_score = -5 }
		}
		else = {
			add_to_variable = { atm_score = atm_pin }
		}
	}
	clr_country_flag = atm_dirty
	set_country_flag = atm_scored
	add_to_variable = { atm_list_rev = 1 }   # the countries tab redraws (dirty)
}

# Values the engine reads just before a run (it may also read some of them itself).
atm_write_inputs = {
	set_variable = { atm_in_humans = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { is_ai = no }
		ROOT = { add_to_variable = { atm_in_humans = 1 } }
	}
	set_variable = { atm_in_civ_free = num_of_available_civilian_factories }
	set_variable = { atm_in_civ_total = num_of_civilian_factories }
	set_variable = { atm_in_fuel = fuel_k }
	set_variable = { atm_in_fuel_max = max_fuel_k }
	set_variable = { atm_in_bal_oil = resource@oil }
	set_variable = { atm_in_bal_aluminium = resource@aluminium }
	set_variable = { atm_in_bal_rubber = resource@rubber }
	set_variable = { atm_in_bal_tungsten = resource@tungsten }
	set_variable = { atm_in_bal_steel = resource@steel }
	set_variable = { atm_in_bal_chromium = resource@chromium }
	set_variable = { atm_in_bal_coal = resource@coal }
}

# Runs the engine. CMD = TICK (daily), APPLY (now), RESET (cancel managed imports and switch off).
# Single player only: with more than one human the engine is not called (the window says so).
atm_run_tick = {
	atm_init = yes
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = atm_dirty } atm_recompute_scores = yes }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = atm_scored } } atm_recompute_scores = yes }
	atm_write_inputs = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { atm_in_humans < 2 } }
		set_variable = { atm_st_ok = 0 }
		log = "ATM:TICK"
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { atm_st_ok = 0 } }
			set_country_flag = atm_no_engine
		}
		else = {
			clr_country_flag = atm_no_engine
		}
	}
}

atm_run_apply = {
	atm_init = yes
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = atm_dirty } atm_recompute_scores = yes }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = atm_scored } } atm_recompute_scores = yes }
	atm_write_inputs = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { atm_in_humans < 2 } }
		set_variable = { atm_st_ok = 0 }
		log = "ATM:APPLY"
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { atm_st_ok = 0 } }
			set_country_flag = atm_no_engine
		}
		else = {
			clr_country_flag = atm_no_engine
		}
	}
}

atm_run_reset = {
	atm_init = yes
	set_variable = { atm_on = 0 }   # otherwise the next day buys everything again
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = atm_dirty } atm_recompute_scores = yes }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = atm_scored } } atm_recompute_scores = yes }
	atm_write_inputs = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { atm_in_humans < 2 } }
		set_variable = { atm_st_ok = 0 }
		log = "ATM:RESET"
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { atm_st_ok = 0 } }
			set_country_flag = atm_no_engine
		}
		else = {
			clr_country_flag = atm_no_engine
		}
	}
}

# Daily (on_daily, player only).
atm_daily_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = atm_initialized }
		atm_run_tick = yes
	}
}

# Settings changed in the window: scores are recomputed and the engine applies it at the next run.
atm_settings_changed = {
	set_country_flag = atm_dirty
	clr_country_flag = atm_reset_armed
}

# Country list for the 'Countries' tab (atm_filter: 0 exporters, 1 all, 2 assigned).
# Assigned countries come first (preferred, then last resort / banned), then the filter's rest.
atm_build_list = {
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = atm_dirty } atm_recompute_scores = yes }
	clear_array = atm_list
	every_country = {
		limit = { exists = yes NOT = { tag = ROOT } check_variable = { atm_pin > 0 } }
		ROOT = { add_to_array = { atm_list = PREV } }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = { exists = yes NOT = { tag = ROOT } check_variable = { atm_pin < 0 } }
		ROOT = { add_to_array = { atm_list = PREV } }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = yes
			NOT = { tag = ROOT }
			check_variable = { atm_pin = 0 }
			OR = {
				check_variable = { ROOT.atm_filter = 1 }
				AND = {
					check_variable = { ROOT.atm_filter = 0 }
					OR = {
						check_variable = { resource_produced@oil > 0 }
						check_variable = { resource_produced@aluminium > 0 }
						check_variable = { resource_produced@rubber > 0 }
						check_variable = { resource_produced@tungsten > 0 }
						check_variable = { resource_produced@steel > 0 }
						check_variable = { resource_produced@chromium > 0 }
						check_variable = { resource_produced@coal > 0 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		ROOT = { add_to_array = { atm_list = PREV } }
	}
	add_to_variable = { atm_list_rev = 1 }
}

# Faction list for the 'Factions' tab: one row per current faction leader (factions change in play,
# so it is rebuilt whenever the tab is opened or refreshed). atm_fcount = members including the leader.
atm_build_flist = {
	clear_array = atm_flist
	every_country = {
		limit = { exists = yes is_faction_leader = yes }
		set_variable = { atm_fcount = 1 }
		every_country = {
			limit = { exists = yes NOT = { tag = PREV } is_in_faction_with = PREV }
			PREV = { add_to_variable = { atm_fcount = 1 } }
		}
		ROOT = { add_to_array = { atm_flist = PREV } }
	}
	add_to_variable = { atm_list_rev = 1 }
}

atm_open_window = {
	atm_init = yes
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = atm_scored } } atm_recompute_scores = yes }
	set_country_flag = atm_gui_open
	clr_country_flag = atm_reset_armed
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_tab = 4 } } atm_build_list = yes }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_tab = 6 } } atm_build_flist = yes }
	add_to_variable = { atm_list_rev = 1 }
}

atm_close_window = {
	clr_country_flag = atm_gui_open
	clr_country_flag = atm_reset_armed
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = atm_dirty } atm_recompute_scores = yes }
	add_to_variable = { atm_list_rev = 1 }
}
